mechanisms.decisive_claim: There are positive-density binary-reservoir blocks with arbitrarily large aggregate transient mass relative to their total eventual density loss.
mechanisms.kill_test: Prove the construction for symbolic Q and R, including complement, CRT density, isolation, and asymptotic ratio.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every target block contained in a fixed-ratio interval [X,cX] has vanishing absolute normalised logarithmic mass as X tends to infinity.
mechanisms.kill_test: Upper-bound it by the harmonic mass of all integers in the interval, uniformly in all congruence data.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Concatenating bounded-ratio finite spike champions can force a nonvanishing oscillation.
mechanisms.kill_test: Apply exact logarithmic dilution at block endpoints and optimise arbitrary superexponential gaps.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Unbounded relative amplification inside a periodic cell implies nonvanishing absolute logarithmic mass.
mechanisms.kill_test: Compare the amplifier with the total harmonic capacity of that cell over the same window.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A nested chain of increasingly sparse cells can preserve a fixed oscillation amplitude while its total density loss stays summable.
mechanisms.kill_test: Track absolute cell density and maximum harmonic capacity down every root-to-leaf path.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Disjoint sparse-cell antichains can collectively preserve fixed oscillation amplitude while paying summable density loss.
mechanisms.kill_test: Sum absolute periodic capacities across each antichain and compare with the available ambient density.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The density-loss measure e_i delta_{log n_i} satisfies a universal Carleson embedding inequality controlling every delayed harmonic tail.
mechanisms.kill_test: Test candidate box constants against symbolic binary reservoirs and exact adversarial multiscale schedules.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: LCM entropy can be charged once when a sparse cell is created and cannot be reused by later target-isolated layers.
mechanisms.kill_test: Construct many later layers sharing the same rare old cell and measure entropy reuse versus additional density loss.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A uniform Abel-discrepancy estimate for disjoint conditional periodic layers follows from finite-stage density convergence alone.
mechanisms.kill_test: Expose the period-dependent boundary term on exact CRT layers and test whether disjointness sums it.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A repeated scale-spanning target-isolated schedule exists with positive survivor density and nonvanishing normalised harmonic oscillation.
mechanisms.kill_test: Run guarded branch-and-bound and relaxed block recurrences, requiring exact scale span, isolation, and density-loss accounting.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/confined_nonaffine_noaffine_search.json and evidence/confined_champion_extension.json: no nonvanishing infinite oscillation constructed; signed finite drops persist but decrease through 60 million indices

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Pairwise target isolation alone supplies the missing cross-scale packing constraint.
mechanisms.kill_test: Build large antichains of moduli in one interval whose targets are pairwise isolated but whose absolute mass still dilutes.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/positive_background_amplifier.md: isolation without absolute scale span is insufficient

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every affine echo family union_r {r+h(cr+b)} with gcd(b,c)=1 has logarithmic density, via an exact transformation to a set of multiples.
mechanisms.kill_test: Prove both directions of the affine divisibility map and transfer Davenport--Erdos density through the required residue progression.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The positive-density tail admits a periodic-cell tree in which fixed-capacity nodes reduce to affine echo/multiples families and the vanishing-capacity remainder is logarithmically negligible.
mechanisms.kill_test: At one fixed old period, classify all conditional echo moduli by gcd and test whether non-affine charts have summable capacity or give a scale-spanning counterexample.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/nonaffine_echo_reduction.md: fixed cells admit nonsummable genuinely non-affine parameter families

mechanisms.decisive_claim: For every fixed C, every union of progressions r_j modulo d_j with both sequences increasing and r_j<d_j<=C r_j has logarithmic density.
mechanisms.kill_test: Use confined positive-density schedules to seek scale-stratified nonvanishing endpoint ranges, and test whether echoes force a logarithmic Cauchy criterion.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A finite union of individually convergent coprime affine echo families can nevertheless have no logarithmic density.
mechanisms.kill_test: Strengthen the affine theorem to upper-log periodic approximation and test stability under finite unions.
